First release: Papyra rebuilt from scratch.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Your notes are plain Markdown files.** Edit them in Papyra or any other app; changes sync both ways and conflicts get a side-by-side resolver.
- **Google Keep-style desk** — masonry cards, pins, colours, archive.
- **Fast full-text search.**
- **Multi-user** — each account gets its own walled-off vault.

### 🚀 Features
- Version history and recovery.
- Picture and file uploads with `![[file]]` embeds.
- Obsidian / Keep import and zip export.
- Real-time updates across tabs and devices.

### 🧰 Self-hosting
- One Docker image serves everything; `PUID`/`PGID` set the file owner.

**Install:** see the [README](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra#readme).
